title: What's New in Cloth NeXt 2.8.1
subtitle: A cleaner startup experience and direct recovery from the viewport.

highlights.title: Present release highlights in a compact premium layout
highlights.description: The dark window uses the new logo, wireframe artwork, and monochrome icons.

highlights.title: Load exact-version highlights from release metadata

highlights.title: Remember whether What's New appears after updates
